raw_excerpt: Chrome for Developers: 'CSS text-wrap: pretty' blog. 'text-wrap: pretty is for generally better line wrapping and text breaking, currently focused on orphans. In the future, text-wrap: pretty may offer more behavior.' Distinction: 'text-wrap: balance' is for headings and short blocks; 'text-wrap: pretty' is for paragraphs to avoid orphans on the last line. Available in Chrome 117+, WebKit/Safari. Part of the Baseline 2024 entry.
